name: swissarmyphotoknife
description: Film light meter and shot logbook: one web page, also installed as an Android app.

scripts.apk: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.phone: npm run apk && adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n com.jarrydwafer.meter/.MainActivity
